meta.name: linkedin-scheduling
meta.description: Optimize LinkedIn posting times, frequency, and the Golden Hour routine. Use when the user asks about best time to post on LinkedIn, posting frequency, content calendar, consistency, content velocity, or the Golden Hour. Do NOT use for content writing (use storytelling) or format selection (use formats).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 优化 LinkedIn 发帖时间和频率
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在运营 LinkedIn 账号，需要提升内容曝光和互动。
copy.tagline_en: Optimize LinkedIn posting times for better engagement
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage a LinkedIn presence and want to maximize reach.

howto.what: 装上后，当你询问 LinkedIn 发布策略时，Claude 会提供最佳发布时间表（如周二至周四早上7:30-8:30）、推荐发布频率（3-4次/周）、内容速度建议，以及发布后一小时的黄金互动流程，并强调主题一致性以提升算法分发。
howto.when: 当用户问到 LinkedIn 最佳发布时间、发布频率或 Golden Hour 流程等话题时触发。

say.text: 我应该在什么时间发 LinkedIn 帖子？
say.note: Claude 会给出按天排列的最佳时段。

say.text: 一周发几次 LinkedIn 最好？
say.note: Claude 会推荐 3-4 次/周的方案。

say.text: 什么是 Golden Hour 流程？
say.note: Claude 会解释发布后一小时的行动步骤。

howto.what_en: After installation, when you ask about LinkedIn posting, Claude provides best posting times (e.g., Tue-Thu 7:30-8:30 AM), recommended frequency (3-4x/week), content velocity insights, the Golden Hour routine for early engagement, and tips for topic consistency.
howto.when_en: Trigger when users ask about best LinkedIn posting time, posting frequency, content calendar, consistency, or the Golden Hour.

say_en.text: What is the best time to post on LinkedIn?
say_en.note: Claude gives optimal slots per day.

say_en.text: How often should I post on LinkedIn?
What is the Golden Hour routine?
say_en.note: Claude explains the actions in the first hour.
